stories.title: A Russian glide bomb kills at least 30 people at a Kramatorsk bus stop
stories.reason: The strike hit two city buses as Russian forces close in on the eastern Donetsk stronghold, the second attack on a bus in Kramatorsk this month, prompting authorities to halt all public transport in the city.

stories.title: OpenAI's revenue is reportedly $20 billion lower than previously reported, triggering an AI stock selloff
stories.reason: The Financial Times reported OpenAI's annualized revenue is nearing $50 billion rather than the $70 billion widely cited last month, a discrepancy traced to how analysts compared it with Anthropic's cloud-partner sales, sending Oracle, CoreWeave and chipmakers sharply lower.

stories.title: A new US indictment charges Maduro and his wife with conspiring to torture Americans and Venezuelans
stories.reason: Prosecutors allege the ousted Venezuelan leader and Cilia Flores ordered electric shocks, beatings and asphyxiation against detainees to silence political opposition, adding a fifth count to the drug-trafficking case against the couple since their January capture.

stories.title: Trump says the US won't attack Iran before November's midterm elections
stories.reason: The pledge reverses remarks from a rally just a day earlier and comes as the war's roughly $3 billion monthly cost and higher gas prices weigh on voters, though Trump said the naval blockade of Iran will stay in place and he has rejected Tehran's latest ceasefire offer.

stories.title: Kenya confirms its first-ever Ebola case and death, linked to the Congo outbreak
stories.reason: A man who had lived in Congo for years died in a Nairobi hospital after symptoms went undetected at airport screening, making Kenya the fourth country hit by an outbreak that has now killed more than 4,000 people since May.

stories.title: Finland orders Google to halt work on two data center sites over environmental violations
stories.reason: Regulators say more than 300 hectares of forest were cleared at the Muhos and Kajaani sites without required impact assessments, threatening delays to Google's €13 billion Finnish investment after the company admitted it fell short of its own standards.

stories.title: South Korea recalls its ambassador to Ukraine in an escalating dispute over North Korean POWs
stories.reason: Seoul says Zelensky broke a confidentiality agreement by revealing a prisoner transfer at the UN, endangering captured soldiers' families in North Korea, and has rejected Kyiv's apology as inadequate even as Ukraine says it wants to keep talking.

stories.title: Maricarmen, the evicted 87-year-old who galvanized Spain's housing protests, has died
stories.reason: She died in hospital just hours before she was due to sign a new lease, two weeks after being carried from her Madrid home on a stretcher when her rent was raised fivefold, a death PM Sanchez mourned publicly as the protests her case sparked reignite.
